_comment: Advisories accepted for the dev-only toolchain, reviewed at each expiry.
An advisory listed here still fails the gate once 'expires' has passed, so
an exception cannot be forgotten. Anything not listed fails immediately at
or above severityFloor. Production dependencies are never exempted: the
published site ships no npm code at all.

exceptions.reason: Reached only via pa11y-ci -> puppeteer -> @puppeteer/browsers when it extracts a Chrome build downloaded from Google's CDN during CI setup. No patched release exists: the advisory covers <=2.0.1 and 2.0.1 is the latest published version. The archive is not attacker-controlled, the code never runs in the published site, and npm's only remediation is a major downgrade of pa11y-ci.
Same package, same reachability and same absence of a patched release as GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv.
